notes: 'gross_loans' field holds total Shariah-compliant Investment (General) -- the Islamic-banking equivalent of loans; 'npl_ratio_pct' holds the Ratio of Classified Investments to Total Investments. Equity was positive in every year 2010-2024 (including the FY2024 loss year), so the dataset's negative-equity-breaks-ROE rule was not triggered for SIBL; roa_pct/roe_pct are populated for all 15 years. UPDATED 2026-08-27: appended 37 Q1/Q2/Q3 interim periods (FY2012 H1 through FY2025 Q3) alongside the existing 15 Q4/annual periods above -- interim periods are distinguished by their 'quarter' field (Q1/Q2/Q3 vs Q4) and each carries its own 'period_type_note' explaining that npl_ratio_pct/car_pct are null (not disclosed in interim filings) and that eps/roa_pct/roe_pct inputs are cumulative-from-Jan-1. roa_pct/roe_pct for interim periods are annualized (x4 for Q1, x2 for Q2, x4/3 for Q3) using average of the prior FY's Q4 total_assets/equity and the current quarter's own total_assets/equity, per this dataset's stated ROA/ROE annualization convention (see _methodology.md); ldr_pct is calculated by this dataset (Investments / Deposits) since SIBL's own interim filings never state this ratio themselves (only its annual report does). Five quarters could not be sourced at all and have no entry here: 2012 Q1 (never published -- SIBL's own site's quarterly archive begins at H1 2012), 2012 Q3 and 2013 Q2 (the PDF at SIBL's own published URL for these periods was, on inspection, a different bank's report -- see sources.json), 2013 Q3 (the bank's own PDF's text layer was pervasively corrupted beyond safe extraction) and 2020 Q1 (PDF had no extractable text layer and was lost to a scratch-directory collision before OCR could be attempted -- see sources.json).
